commands.name: workshop.refresh

commands.description: Call exactly once; target's safety is unchanged
commands.name: workshop.call

commands.description: List the app's commands with labels, shortcuts and enablement
commands.name: workshop.actions

commands.description: Run one app command by id, as its menu item or shortcut would (file.refresh, file.quit, edit.format, edit.clear, edit.copy, bus.call, help.shortcuts, help.about)
commands.name: workshop.execute

commands.description: Close when idle
commands.name: workshop.quit

commands.description: The rows the services tree shows: key, kind, label, depth, expanded, selected, children
commands.name: workshop.tree

commands.description: The reply panel's text and the last reply's value
commands.name: workshop.reply

commands.description: Set the services filter, as typing in the search field does
commands.name: workshop.filter

commands.description: Set the JSON body; refused while a call holds it
commands.name: workshop.body

commands.description: Set the services pane's share of the window
commands.name: workshop.split

args.size: optional number 0..1, clamped to pane limits

commands.description: Set the Traffic dock placement and share of the window
commands.name: workshop.dock

commands.description: Open or close a tree row that has children
commands.name: workshop.expand

commands.description: Select any tree row; a command row also selects its command
commands.name: workshop.select_row

commands.description: Open a dialog, or close the open one
commands.name: workshop.dialog

args.caption_side: optional right, left or null to follow the session
args.decorations: optional auto, csd, ssd or null to follow the session
args.mode: optional light, dark or null to follow the session
args.scheme: optional scheme name (ocean, crimson, stone, forest, sunset, mono, pro, studio, classic, breeze, adwaita) or null to follow the session
args.style: optional style (plain, pro, studio, classic, breeze, adwaita), own for the scheme's own, or null to follow the session

commands.description: Choose the window's theme: a present key sets that axis, an absent one leaves it; answers the choice and every effective axis, including decorations and decorations_reason
commands.name: workshop.theme

commands.description: Read this node, peers, bounded per-link and local traffic totals, one and five minute windows, top services and commands, ping results with age, and observation state; only this broker is observed
commands.name: workshop.mesh

commands.description: Ping each known peer once with a two second deadline; returns {pinging:[names]} immediately; results appear in workshop.mesh; refuses overlapping rounds
commands.name: workshop.mesh.ping

commands.description: Every node's agentd sessions as the Agents branch shows them ({nodes:[{node, local, available, error, live, max_live, sessions}], selected:{node, session}, filter}), and the selected session's transcript (first, last, events, evicted, gap, filling, items)
commands.name: workshop.agents

args.node: optional node (default the one node listing the id)

commands.description: Select an agent session in the Agents branch; its transcript is read back from agentd's log, then followed live on this node (a peer's is read again on refresh). An id listed by two nodes without node is refused (AMBIGUOUS_SESSION, rc 10)
commands.name: workshop.agents.select

args.node: optional node (default every node with agentd)

commands.description: List one or every node's agentd sessions again, and read the selected session on from its last event; answers {refreshing:[nodes]}
commands.name: workshop.agents.refresh

args.agent: optional agent name, or null for every agent
args.ended: optional bool: open or close every node's Ended row
args.node: optional node, or null for every node

commands.description: Narrow the Agents list; answers the filter and the live and ended counts it shows
commands.name: workshop.agents.filter

commands.description: Start an agent session through agentd and select it; refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp, which calls agent.* directly
commands.name: workshop.agents.new

args.session: optional session id (default the selected one)

commands.description: Send a prompt to an agent session; refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp, which calls agent.* directly
commands.name: workshop.agents.prompt

args.session: optional session id (default the selected one)

commands.description: Cancel the session's running turn; refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp, which calls agent.* directly
commands.name: workshop.agents.cancel

args.session: optional session id (default the selected one)

commands.description: End the session's agent; it stays in agentd's log and can be resumed; refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp, which calls agent.* directly
commands.name: workshop.agents.close

args.session: optional session id (default the selected one)

commands.description: Bring back an ended session; refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp, which calls agent.* directly
commands.name: workshop.agents.resume

args.option: a config option id, with value
args.session: optional session id (default the selected one)

commands.description: Set a session's mode or config option (model, effort, ...); refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp, which calls agent.* directly
commands.name: workshop.agents.set

args.option: one of the optionIds it offers (never allow_always)
args.session: optional session id (default the selected one)

commands.description: Answer an open permission question through agentd (agent.permission.respond); refused (USE_AGENT, rc 17) to an agent session's own mixos-mcp. The window's buttons answer only for a person: a ui.click on them is refused (HUMAN_ONLY)
commands.name: workshop.agents.answer

commands.description: Read the bounded traffic ring
commands.name: workshop.traffic

commands.description: Control broker observation; topic rows remain after refusal
commands.name: workshop.observe

commands.description: Select a macro and read its document
commands.name: workshop.macros.open

commands.description: Create a macro, select it and open its document
commands.name: workshop.macros.new

host.help:
workshop — native ABP service and command browser
Usage: workshop [--debug[=LEVEL]] [--headless] [--noded-url URL] [--service NAME] [--comp NAME]
Levels: off|error|warn|info|debug|trace (default warn; --debug means debug)
host.title: Workshop
